title: Cash Pickup Shortfall Credits: Delay Amount for Slow Error Findings
content:
**Customer remediation schedule.** A delay amount is added to Paloma's shortfall credit on a Cash Pickup transfer when the error-resolution team took a long time to find the error.

**Days counted.** The calendar days from the date of the customer's incorrect-amount notice to the date of the finding that an error occurred. The notice day is not counted.

| Days from notice to finding | Delay amount added to the shortfall credit |
|---|---|
| more than 14 | accrues per day: the number of days multiplied by 0.10 USD, rounded half up to the cent |
| from 8 up to 14 | a flat 0.75 USD, whatever the exact number of days |
| fewer than 8 | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical notice on 1 April)

| Finding of error dated | Days | Delay amount |
|---|---|---|
| 8 April | 7 | none |
| 9 April | 8 | 0.75 |
| 15 April | 14 | 0.75 |
| 16 April | 15 | 1.50 |
| 24 April | 23 | 2.30 |

At 14 days the flat amount still applies. From 15 days the amount is worked out by the day, using all of the days, not only those beyond 14.
